observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 147.» (L16) in the right margin. The signature 13 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
body L1: a speck stands over the n of «nequit»; it is not an accent.
body L24: a speck stands at the head of the e of «erit»; it is not a sign.
body L35: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 43 the letters begin again at a.
notes_right L7, L9: the two lines of ratios are centred in the column. In the first the slash of the last fraction is printed broken.
notes_right L9: the last fraction is printed 36/58; 77 : 29 1/2 = 154/59 = 2 36/59; kept as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
